content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIEST Shibpur Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 13-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIEST Shibpur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIEST Shibpur is 13th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M. Sc. in Chemistry and have qualified in CSIR-UGC NET or GATE to be eligible for the Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIEST Shibpur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 48,100/- per month, which includes a basic pay of Rs. 37,000/- and 30% HRA (Rs. 11,100/-).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 32 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Woman and Physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation of up to 5 years is provided for SC/ST/OBC/Woman and Physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How will the candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a walk-in interview, followed by physical document verification at the time of joining.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit a soft copy of their application letter, recent bio-data, and self-attested mark sheets and certificates via email.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the designated email addresses provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIEST Shibpur located?
faq.answer: IIEST Shibpur is located in Shibpur, West Bengal, with the pincode 711103.
